notes: The Honour Arena's kit: the six league emblems the ladder names (pvp.json arena.leagues[].emblem is exactly arena/league_<id>, and Art.tex draws magenta for a key it cannot find), and the three portrait frames the top of the ladder and the Throne hand out.

The emblems are cut at the painting's own size and never scaled here: the league card draws one down into its 248-wide window, and 'paint big, draw down' is the rule. The frames follow frames_cosmetic_a.json exactly -- one scale per kind so every plain band comes out the same size (square 160, ring 96, the large ring 132, the wardrobe tile 190) -- so an arena frame and a wardrobe frame sit the same on the same portrait.

frames/imperial is the Throne's regalia, not the arena's, which is why it alone carries no arena_ prefix: the Crowned Emperor wears it for the reign (pvp.json throne.emperor_frame), and the arena's Imperial league is the other way to earn it.
Keyed off the sheet's own flat navy [8,21,31], measured from its border. Each frame is masked to its own rect so a neighbour's ornament cannot reach into it.
